declarations: R1: no stance below rests on a bracket. R41: no Valen flag is a reason. market_void is null throughout: my method carries no market kill line.
Breaks at the test (C7) get ACT_NOW on a sign-of-strength buy stop above bar_high (C12); names away from value get WAIT for the Creek test (R2, C3, C15).

answers.text: 'Weekly 6.3% under the 20-wk high, not a new high.' My test is not a new high but the test of the broken Creek (C7): D 9>21 at 0.4% under the 20-day high, H1 87% of range. Break volume is graded at rvol_20d 1.26 against my 1.0/1.2 stand-ins (R3, R6), not 1.40. W gap is a top-down caution (C16), already in my case against; not a refutation.

'rvol_20d 1.31 under 1.40: a hard rejection.' 1.40 is not my threshold: R3 grades a genuine break at rvol_20d >= 1.0 and R6 a sign-of-strength bar at >= 1.2; 1.31 passes both. The refuter grants W/D HH/HL; H1 closes at 96% of range. Break stands on my test.

'RS rank under 70 and the 50-day under the 100.' Neither is a Wyckoff test. Mine is C11 rejection at the value edge: W 9>21 HH/HL, D above EMA9 9>21, H1 68% of range after the probe under pvp_vah closed back above it. The template fails a different method; my read stands, still only a spring candidate until follow-through.
